# Printed Hole Diameter

Smallest hole that prints open and close to size.

<figure markdown="span">
![Printed Hole Diameter: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-printed-hole-diameter-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Printed Hole Diameter: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-printed-hole-diameter-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Diameter of printed holes; small ones come out undersized or close up.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Medium |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Medium |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 2.0 mm | 1.0 mm | Not yet sourced |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.8 mm | 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2: 0.8 mm")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 3 and 4: 0.5 mm") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 1.5 mm | 1.0 mm | Aim for: Published, [Hubs](../../citations/bibliography.md#hubs-sls "1.5 mm"), [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf)<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "1 mm"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls) |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Small hole (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Small printed holes come out undersized and rough. Enlarge it, or drill or ream it to size after printing.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Hole too small to print (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. It may close up entirely. Enlarge it, or print it solid and drill it afterwards.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Small hole (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Excess resin cures at the edges of small holes, so they come out undersized. Enlarge it, or drill it to size after printing.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Hole may close up (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. Cured resin will likely seal it. Enlarge it, or print it solid and drill it.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Small hole (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Heat from the laser fuses powder at its edge, so small holes come out undersized and are hard to clear. Enlarge it, or ream it.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Hole may close up (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. Fused powder will likely fill it. Enlarge it, or drill it after printing.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
